name: jyu_lump
desc: The bear man has completely melted down: replace the whole character with a shapeless, heaving mass of the same glossy brown paint with cream swirls, rising from a wide puddle on the floor at the same spot: a low, wide, heavy rounded mound about half of his height and as wide as his big belly, sagging and squashed under its own weight, with big swelling bubbles. No head, no face, no arms, no shoulders, no legs, no body shapes at all, just thick sticky goo welling up, bubbles swelling and popping, sticky strands. Same colors, outline and pixel art style.
